goal: Generate a product poster in a high-tech, engineering aesthetic style, featuring a vertical exploded view of the Tesla Cybertruck, flanked by technical callouts, suitable as the main visual for a product launch or technical highlight image on a detail page.
subject: Tesla Cybertruck Electric Pickup

style.rendering: Minimalist high-tech 3D rendering, studio lighting, car body skin edges outlined with cool color highlights
style.background_color: Soft gradient from deep space gray to electric blue
style.lighting: Studio overhead light + faint cool edge light, with a subtle ionization ambient light between layers.

header.subtitle: Reimagining the future on the road with wire control and an integrated shell.

layout.centerpiece: Tesla Cybertruck Vertical Stacked Exploded View, 9 Layers from Bottom to Top: 800V High Nickel Battery Pack and Thermal Management Chassis, Front Dual Motor and Rear Single Motor Three-Motor Drive Axle, Drive-by-Wire Steering and All-Wheel Steering Actuators, Stainless Steel Exoskeleton Side Panels and Underbody Shield, Ultra-Hard Cold-Rolled Stainless Steel Outer Skin Triangular Cross Section, Armored Glass Windshield with Folding Wiper Mechanism, Wiring Domain Controller and 48V Low Voltage Power Distribution Unit, Cyberpunk Minimalist Cabin Frame and Yoke Steering Column Interface, Retractable Rear Bed Cover and Cargo Bed Lighting Module

left_side: 800V 架构电池组\nTesla 高压平台，续航与充放电效率的底座。
三电机驱动与扭矩矢量\n公路与轻越野场景下的动力分配。
线控转向 + 全轮转向\n减少机械连接，为数字化底盘预留空间。
right_side: 不锈钢 Exoskeleton 外壳\n低维护成本的一体化承力蒙皮。
角折造型与低风阻面\n在辨识度与空气动力学之间做工程取舍。
装甲玻璃 + 大倾角 A 柱\n结构刚度与视野的折中。
域控线束 + 热管理\n高功率工况下的稳定配电与散热。
可拓展货斗与照明\n工作灯与后斗接口支持户外与载具场景。

left_text_block.headline: Experience, stemming from the evolution of structure.
left_text_block.body: From chassis central to stainless steel shell, each module is designed for durability and efficiency in the electric era. Cybertruck showcases the future in an engineering-transparent way, making technology itself the narrative.

must_keep: Clear Sense of Component Hierarchy with Appropriate Distances Between Layers
callout leader line points to the correct component
The top logo and bottom brand area must not overlap with components
Overall, it looks like a high-end release event poster.
avoid: Overly Dense Component Expansion Results in Lack of Clarity
callout text too long causing line breaks to be confusing
The direction of light is not unified
Instances of Penetration or Interspersing Between Components
